overview.title: Identity
overview.description: Which identity sources need attention now? Windows security events by source. Times are UTC.
overview.forbiddenText: This page needs the {permission} permission. Ask an administrator to grant it.
overview.failedTitle: Identity sources could not be loaded
overview.failedText: The identity sources could not be read, so nothing is known about them. Reload the page. If it keeps failing, check the backend log.
overview.expiredText: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
overview.emptyText: Nothing is collected, which is not a clean result. An administrator with the admin:identity permission sets the field mapping on a log source's identity page, /behavior/identity/sources/ followed by the log source id, then validates and enables it.
overview.lead: <num>{collected}</num> of <num>{total}</num> sources are collected: enabled and validated for their current profile. <num>{attention}</num> need attention, listed first. A source that is not collected produces no counts and no verdicts.
overview.incidentsFailed: The open incidents could not be read, so their column shows a dash. A dash is not zero incidents.
overview.incidentsCapped: Only {shown} of {total} open incidents were read. The per-source incident counts are at least what is shown.
overview.countsNote: Events summed over the five-minute buckets measured whole. At least means a bucket in the range was truncated, not collected or not stored. A dash means nothing was measured. Successful logons (4624) are not collected.
overview.countsCapped: Counts are read for the first {cap} of {total} sources. Open a source to read the others.

tooltip.namesCut: The name list of this bucket is cut or was not collected.

chart.noneTitle: No count was measured in this range.
chart.noneText: Event {event} has no stored count here. That is not the same as zero events. Try a wider range or check the source's collection state.
chart.summary: {exact} buckets measured whole, {truncated} truncated, {missing} not collected.
chart.keyTruncated: {count, plural, one {# bucket at its floor (shaded)} other {# buckets at their floor (shaded)}}
chart.keyNotCollected: {count, plural, one {# bucket not collected} other {# buckets not collected}}
chart.note: A gap is a bucket nothing was measured in, never zero. No expected range is drawn: the API serves no baseline for identity counts.

names.label: Stored usernames
names.caption: Usernames stored for event {event} over the range
names.emptyTitle: No username is stored for this event in the range.
names.emptyText: Either no event had a username that qualified, or none occurred. The counts above say which.
names.emptyIncomplete: A name search in this range was cut or did not run, so a missing name is not proof it was absent.
names.incomplete: A name search in this range was cut or did not run. The list below is not the whole top.
names.noteVolume: Names below {floor} events in a bucket are not stored, so a name's figure is at least what the stored rows show.
names.noteRare: Every name is stored from one event.
names.noteTop: Only the top {top} per bucket are kept.

source.title: Identity source
source.description: What did the stored events of this source say, and how whole is that? Times are UTC.
source.noProfileDescription: This log source has no identity profile yet.
source.failedTitle: The identity source could not be loaded
source.failedText: The source could not be read, so nothing is known about it. Reload the page. If it keeps failing, check the backend log.
source.forbiddenTitle: You cannot read this identity source
source.forbiddenText: This page needs the {permission} permission. Ask an administrator to grant it.
source.notFoundTitle: This log source was not found
source.notFoundText: It may have been removed. Open the list of identity sources and choose another.

whyBanner.disabled: This profile is not enabled, so the source is not collected and has no verdicts. Counts below are what was stored earlier.
whyBanner.unvalidated: This profile is not validated, so the source is not collected. Counts below are what was stored earlier.
whyBanner.stale: The profile changed after it was last validated, so the source is not collected until it is validated again.

source.noEvents: No catalogue event is enabled on this profile.

profile.heading: Profile
profile.noneTitle: This log source has no identity profile.
profile.noneAdmin: Set the field mapping below, validate it, then enable collection.
profile.noneReader: Setting up a profile needs the {permission} permission.
profile.eventIdHelp: The QRadar property that holds the numeric Windows event ID.
profile.forbidden: You need the {permission} permission for this.
profile.readOnly: Changing the profile needs the {permission} permission.
profile.setNote: Saving a new mapping stops collection until the profile is validated again.
profile.saved: Mapping saved. Validate it before enabling.
profile.disableNote: Disable stops collection. Stored buckets stay.
profile.enableNote: Enable starts collection of this source's events every 15 minutes, read only.
profile.enableBlocked: Enable is available once the current version is validated.

investigation.summary: {event}: {observed} events in the bucket against an expected {expected}.
investigation.summaryNoExpected: {event}: {observed} events in the bucket. No expected count was stored.
investigation.floorNote: The search was truncated: the count is at least the value shown.
investigation.namesPartial: The name search was cut or did not run, so the usernames below are not the whole top.
investigation.noNames: No username is stored on this incident.
investigation.noNamesVolume: No username is stored on this incident. For this event, names below {floor} events in a bucket are not stored.
investigation.namesCaption: Usernames stored for {event} on this incident
investigation.namesNote: Only the top {top} names per bucket are kept, and a name's count is what its stored row says.
